name: Wedge Industrial Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wedge Industrial Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of micro-ecological live bacteria products, superalloys, and related products in China. It offers microecological preparations, such as bifidobacterium lactobacillus triple live bacteria tablets under the Golden Bifidobacterium brand; vaginal lactobacillus live capsules under the Dingjun Sheng brand; dual-span microecological live bacteria drugs under the Jin Shuangqi brand; and vaginal microecological live bacteria drug for use in the treatment of gynecological infections under the Dingjunsheng brand.
